transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... well, things haven't been right for a while now. It's my husband's family. They've been... interfering. Quietly messing with our money, our reputation. I see it happening, like when these little billing errors pop up at my job, or people at church start acting strange around me. Nobody else seems to get it, and no matter what records they show me, I just know it all ties back to them.
You believe his family is behind these issues, can you tell me more about why you think that?

I... well, like I just said, it's obvious to me. I work in billing, so I see it when these little errors just start showing up out of nowhere. They're messing with our money. And our good name, too. The people at church acting funny... it's not a coincidence. 

People try to pull up all these records and statements to prove me wrong, but... paper doesn't mean anything to me. I know what I see. I know it comes back to his family. I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Do you think other people can see these connections between his family and the problems you're experiencing, or do you feel like you're the only one who understands what's going on?

I don't know. I haven't really asked anyone. 

I guess... I guess most people don't see it. They just go along with their day and don't pay attention. I don't really talk to other people about it anyway.
Do you still believe his family is behind these issues when you're alone and not thinking about it?

I mean... it doesn't just turn off. 

Even if I'm sitting by myself, they're still out there doing it. Like I said, I've been trying for months to get people to understand this. Being alone doesn't change the fact that they're quietly messing with our money and our name. It's just... always happening. I don't really know how else to explain it to you.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
No. I don't... hear things like that. Just regular sounds.
Have you ever considered the possibility that his family might not be behind these issues?

No. I haven't. 

Because... well, it's just too obvious. I told you, I've been trying for months to get people to understand this. It's not just in my head. When little billing errors show up at my job, or... or when someone at church suddenly acts funny toward me... it's them. They're quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

I know it ties back to them. No matter what records anyone pulls up, or what anyone says. I just know it.
How certain are you that his family is behind these issues?
I'm completely certain. I mean... I wouldn't be sitting here if I wasn't. Like I said, no matter what records people try to show me, I know it's them. I just know.
Has there ever been a time when you doubted that his family was behind these issues?

No. Never. 

I mean... I already told you. I've been trying for months to get people to understand this. When the billing errors happen at work, or the church people act weird... it's them. They're messing with our money and our name. 

There's no doubt. I know it's them.
Do you think that events or things you see on TV, or read in the newspaper, are somehow related to you or your situation?
No. Not really. I don't watch much TV anyway. It's just his family doing things directly to us.
Has anything ever happened that made you question or reconsider your beliefs about his family's involvement?

No. Nothing like that. 

I don't know why we keep going over this. I told you why I'm here. I've spent months trying to get people to just... listen. To understand what his family is doing. The money issues, the way people at church are acting... it's them. I don't need to reconsider anything because I know what's happening. The records don't matter. It's them.
Is there anything that could potentially change your mind about his family being behind these issues?

No. Why would I? 

I... I don't know why you keep asking me if I'll change my mind. I'm here because I've spent months trying to get someone to understand what they are doing. My husband's family is quietly messing with our money and our good name. 

When those little billing errors show up at work... or when someone at church suddenly acts funny toward me... it's them. No matter what records anyone pulls up to try and prove otherwise, I know it ties back to them. So no, nothing is going to change my mind.
For how long have you believed that your husband's family is behind these issues?
About nine months. It started... well, after some trouble with them over money. And some holiday things. That's when it began.
Was there anything unusual or stressful happening in your life around the time you first started to believe his family was interfering with your affairs, about nine months ago?
No. Just... what I already said. The disagreement over the money. Other than that, no. Everything else was just normal.
Are these thoughts about your husband's family interfering with your daily life or causing you a lot of distress?

Not really. I mean... I haven't lost my job or anything like that. I still take care of my usual responsibilities. 

It's just... well, my husband and I have had more arguments lately. And there are some awkward moments at church, mostly because people think I should just drop it. But other than that, no. I'm still doing everything I normally do.
Do you think there's any possibility, no matter how small, that you might be mistaken about his family's involvement?

No. I'm not mistaken. I know what I see. 

I've been trying to get people to understand this for months. It's not just the money we disagreed about... it's other things now. Little billing errors show up at my work. People at church suddenly acting funny toward me, like they've been talking. It's his family messing with our finances and our good name. 

People say I'm wrong, they pull up records or whatever, but... I know it ties back to them. I just know it.
